_comment: One tile, the whole network (155 IR ops, 539037632 MACs). @generated by phase1_bindings.py from the board's own compose verdicts (results/phase1_compose.json) — a lane appears here only if qnn-context-binary-generator returned rc=0 for it on this board. Model is modelblaster.models.yolov8_nano_sf from the zoo at /scratch/dima/rose-infra/RoSE/soc/sw/xpu-rt/zephyr-chipyard-sw/modelblaster, exported to ONNX at opset 17 and converted with snpe-onnx-to-dlc; the int8 lanes come from the qairt-quantizer output over 10 seeded synthetic calibration samples.
_scaled_variant_note: dronet and mlp_control non-default rungs keep SEEDED RANDOM INIT — the trained checkpoint only fits the default geometry — so they are valid latency and scheduling targets and must never be quoted as an accuracy result. yolov8_nano rungs are the exception: channel counts are input-size independent, so get_model() loads the COCO checkpoint at every rung. fastdepth has no committed checkpoint at all and is always seeded-random.
_rewrite_note: Lane(s) ['hta', 'dsp'] come from the rewritten variant yolov8_nano_sf_hta (chain ['onnxsim', 'channel_slice_to_conv1x1'], NUMERICS-PRESERVING), adopted because it measured better on that lane. HTA rejects StridedSlice, which is how the converter lowers the C2f channel chunk that modelblaster exports as a Slice pair. The 1x1 selector convolution computes the same tensor with an op HTA has.
_precision_note: The CPU lane's precision is chosen per tile on measured evidence, not per network: cpu=int8, dsp=int8, gpu=fp16, hta=int8
